diamond-crown--diamond-crown-classic.description: Created in 1995 with Carlos Fuente Jr. for J.C. Newman's centenary, this Dominican cigar from Tabacalera A. Fuente wraps a Dominican binder and a five-tobacco filler in a twice-fermented, five-year-old Connecticut Shade leaf, and each lot rests at least a year after rolling. It smokes creamy and gentle, with soft sweetness, nuts, cedar and coffee, suited to a calm late morning.

thirds.notes: A soft, sweet start of butterscotch-like and orchard-fruit tones over light coffee and earth, with a gentle edge of pepper.
Almond-like nuttiness and darker coffee move forward, with an earthy, faintly salty edge and a trace of citrus peel.
Cedar and espresso take the lead, sweetness returns briefly, and spice and body build toward the close.

The Cigar Authority – Diamond Crown No. 4 review

diamond-crown--diamond-crown-maduro.description: The Maduro version of Diamond Crown keeps the Classic's Dominican binder and five-tobacco filler, rolled at Tabacalera A. Fuente, but dresses them in a dark, oily Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper. Sweet and toasty, it opens on leather, earth and pepper, gathers cocoa or cherry-like sweetness with cedar through the middle, and closes on sweet leather with little bite.

thirds.notes: Leather and earth lead, with black pepper and a touch of hay over a sweet finish.
The pepper eases; dark cocoa or cherry-like sweetness joins cedar and leather, with spice building on the retrohale.
Sweet leather takes over, carried by cocoa, earth and a few nutty tones, smoother than before.

diamond-crown--diamond-crown-maximus.description: Developed by Carlos Fuente Jr. and Stanford J. Newman for J.C. Newman's 105th anniversary, Maximus wraps five-year-aged Dominican binder and filler in a dark El Bajo sun-grown leaf, grown in Ecuador by John Oliva Sr. and reserved for this cigar. Rolled at Tabacalera A. Fuente, it is a bold, rich and complex blend; the blend was refined and repackaged in 2026.

diamond-crown--diamond-crown-black-diamo.description: Black Diamond is a small-batch Diamond Crown from Tabacalera A. Fuente, with a Connecticut Havana wrapper over a binder and filler of five-year-aged Dominican tobaccos. J.C. Newman places it at full strength: a bold, full-bodied counterpart to the creamy Classic, made in three sizes from the short Radiant to the Emerald toro.

sources.title: J.C. Newman – Diamond Crown Black Diamond

diamond-crown--diamond-crown-julius-caes.description: Launched in 2010 for J.C. Newman's 115th anniversary and the 135th birthday of founder Julius Caeser Newman, whose portrait appears on the band, this Tabacalera A. Fuente cigar sets an Ecuadorian Havana-seed wrapper over a Dominican binder and a blended filler. The company rates it medium in strength, with a bold, flavourful wrapper; the Troublemaker is a soft perfecto version.
